The auditor walks back: Saturn in Pisces until 10 December
Who walks back: never the Sun and the Moon; next Jupiter on 12 December, Mars on 10 January

Rule 14: before it turns, a graha stops, a key factor in its strength
Two stops: Saturn turns forward on 10 December, Jupiter backward on 12 December
Inside the backward stretch: Pisces 21° to 14°, and Leo 3° to Cancer 23°
